neighbours.label: The split-off opening pieces Tan-, Tanz-, Tang-, -anz- and Fund- of place names (Tanzanian, Tangier, Zanzibar, Tanjore, Fundy); whole-token place names stay quiet
fire: Dealers in Arusha sell cut Tanzanite to visitors from abroad.
Our guide was a Tanzanian biologist who knew every bird in the park.
The ferry from Dar es Salaam reached Zanzibar shortly before sunset.
The writer spent two winters in Tangier and finished her novel there.
Lake Tanganyika is the deepest lake on the African continent.
The temple at Tanjore was built by a Chola king in the eleventh century.
Whales feed in the cold waters of the Bay of Fundy every summer.
Villagers near the Tanana River hunt moose in the autumn.
quiet: Dealers in Nairobi sell cut gemstones to visitors from abroad.
Our guide was a Kenyan biologist who knew every bird in the park.
The ferry from Athens reached Crete shortly before sunset.
The writer spent two winters in Lisbon and finished her novel there.
Lake Victoria is the largest lake on the African continent.
The temple in Bangkok was built by a Thai king in the eighteenth century.
Whales feed in the cold waters of the Gulf of Alaska every summer.
Villagers near the Amazon River hunt tapir in the autumn.

notes: Card: ' Tanz' x6, ' Tan' x3, 'anz' x3, ' Fund', but also ' United' x6. Probe: Tanjung 0.89, Tanzanian 0.73, Fundy 0.71, Zanzibar 0.63, Tanganyika 0.56; whole token ' Tanzania' only 0.08, Paris 0.00, 'trust fund' 0.02. Other split place names weaker (Biscay 0.31, Titicaca 0.23, Timbuktu 0.21), so a general 'piece of a split place name' label is not claimed. ' United' reached 0.30 and is not covered.
